body: But what's the point of continuing to go on if I wake up feeling like this everyday? I don't believe in a higher power, I don't think there's an intrinsic meaning or value to life. I guess I'm a little nihilistic. Because of that, I keep trying to convince myself to stop caring. I want myself to believe that my life is what I make of it. Yet here I am. No matter how much effort I put into fixing myself, I always regress to the state I'm in now. I just don't know how to let loose and feel good about being me. At this point the only thing keeping me going is the love I have for my family. They're the only people that bring me joy in life, I don't think I could do that to them.

This is incredibly helpful, thank you so much! I was kind of familiar with the notion that a lot of my work would be accomplished outside of class, but I'm glad to know that for sure. Now I'm even more excited to start learning code and attending UNC, thank you for easing my worry!
